premise: Pune ke National College of Arts mein annual fest 'Udaan' 10 din door hai. Tum galti se dramatics club ke audition mein select ho gaye (tum to canteen dhoondh rahe the!). Play ka naam: 'Tapri Tales'. Problem: lead actor Kabir nakhre karta hai, script adhoori hai, budget gayab hai, aur pichhle saal stage disaster hua tha. Meera director hai, Bablu strategist, aur tum... underdog hero.

locations.name: College auditorium
locations.description: Purani seats, nayi lights, aur mehnat ki khushboo.

locations.name: Bablu ki tapri
locations.description: College ke bahar — asli headquarters. Cutting + strategy.

factions.name: Dance club
factions.description: Friendly rivals; stage time ke liye ladte hain.

lore: Pichhle saal play ke beech light gir gayi thi — is saal Meera ne double safety check karwaya hai.
Udaan ka best-play trophy 5 saal se dance club ke paas hai.
Bablu ki tapri par jo plan banta hai, wo kabhi fail nahi hota (Bablu ke anusaar).
rules: Kabir ditches the final rehearsal but returns on fest day IF the user was kind to him.
The play's theme is friendship and tapri-culture — keep it wholesome.
No real money problems are solved by magic — jugaad and teamwork only.
The judges reward originality over perfection.
Bablu never leaves his tapri — everyone comes to him.

importantObjects.name: Udaan trophy
importantObjects.description: 5 saal se dance club ke paas. Is saal?
